contract.plan_sha256_method: SHA256 of canonical compact JSON (sorted keys, UTF-8, separators comma/colon) after replacing contract.plan_sha256 with 64 ASCII zeroes.
contract.stop_condition: Complete only after E22 and E23 PASS, E24 reconciles 180/180 real-reader cells, all 30 adversarial cells, two byte-identical replays, 100% rollback and quarantine, and every frozen E03 hard gate; otherwise REWORK with winner_selected=false and pilot_authorized=false.

repository_evidence.fact: Production blue/green deployment, health gate, rollback, and slot teardown exist; Round 7 must implement a separate expiring non-production harness and must never call this against production.
Bearer tokens back session[api_token]; POST /v1/auth/login-tickets mints a single-use 60-second ticket consumed by GET /login/ticket/:ticket for authenticated Studio.
The real public reader is /papers/:slug and the exact email byte stream is /papers/:slug/email.
Email HTML is renderable, but this controller neither delivers a message nor proves transport receipt or real-client open.
Bare bp loads schemas from the resolved API configuration and runs the real Bubble Tea TUI; positional arguments use the manifest-driven CLI.
BLOCKED with 0/108 accepted captures: no isolated expiring deployment, authenticated Studio session, or bound public/CLI provenance.
BLOCKED with 0/72 because E19 did not PASS; no real TUI or delivered real-client email evidence.
Correctly stopped before sealing/scoring with 0/180 accepted real-reader cells and no winner or pilot.

prohibitions: No proxy evidence, source-only render, URL reflection, pdrender, stdout dump, browser email preview, endpoint HTML, raw MIME alone, fabricated frame, or synthetic screenshot may count as a real-reader capture.
No synthetic backfill, borrowed prior-round capture, threshold or rubric weakening, missing-cell scoring, post-seal mutation, aggregate override, or N/A substitution is permitted.
No production deployment or content mutation is permitted; target, database, workspace, hostname, expiry, and teardown must prove isolation before any write.
No winner may be selected unless every hard gate passes; no pilot may be authorized without winner_selected=true.

assignments.title: Provision isolated candidate and prove authenticated Studio, public reader, and CLI
assignments.dependency_behavior: Run first. Any missing isolation, expiry, teardown, credentials, auth, or provenance returns BLOCKED/REWORK, tears down, and prevents E23 and E24.

capability_classification.capability: isolation guard, TTL/expiry, candidate loader, provenance binding, teardown verifier
Studio ticket/session, public /papers/:slug, manifest-driven CLI retrieval
isolated host/database allocation and admin token authority
capability_classification.blocker: An authorized operator must supply a provably non-production target and short-lived credentials; values must not be persisted.

runnable_implementation_path: Implement E22/scripts/preflight.py to reject production host/database/workspace, require TTL<=120, hash all frozen inputs, and prove a teardown command before writes.

Implement E22/scripts/provision.py to materialize exactly 36 capsule-backed scratch records, stamp candidate/deployment/fixture digests, mint no production data, and emit deployment-manifest.json with expiry.
Use POST /v1/auth/login-tickets then GET /login/ticket/:ticket for the real authenticated Studio session; use /papers/:slug for public reader and the built bp CLI against the same deployment.
Implement E22/scripts/capture.py and verify.py to seal 108 unique browser/CLI cells with timestamps, session/invocation metadata, semantic capture, screenshot/transcript, and SHA256.
acceptance_gates: One non-production deployment has creation/expiry/teardown proof and 36/36 capsule-backed records with one candidate digest.
Exactly 108/108 unique cells are real and provenance-bound; Studio is authenticated, public reader resolves deployed records, and CLI retrieves the same records.
Every applicable frozen E03 hard gate passes, zero proxy/missing/duplicate/blank cells exist, and rollback plus teardown is 36/36 and 100%.
rejection_gates: Reject on production ambiguity, secret persistence, login redirect, anonymous Studio, URL reflection, API-only Studio substitute, provenance drift, missing cell, silent blank, cross-tenant exposure, or teardown failure.

rollback_and_teardown.action: Delete or restore all 36 scratch records, revoke runtime credentials/tickets, terminate deployment, verify endpoint unavailable and zero residual records; failure is FAIL.

hashes.required_outputs: SHA256 for every capture and artifact, deployment id/digest, candidate digest, fixture digest, and aggregate index digest

assignments.two_replay_requirements: Two verifier replays over the sealed deployment/capture artifacts must produce identical canonical hashes and PASS bytes; they must not redeploy or mutate records.

assignments.title: Prove real TUI selection and delivered-message real-client email
assignments.dependency_behavior: Start only when E22 is PASS and its deployment, candidate digest, fixture digest, and 108-cell index are immutable; otherwise record NOT_STARTED/BLOCKED and do not launch TUI or send mail.

capability_classification.capability: real bp schema load, interactive selection, PTY capture, candidate binding
SMTP delivery receipt, controlled mailbox, named real-client open and capture
capability_classification.blocker: Requires external transport/mailbox credentials and human or authorized GUI-client control; endpoint HTML is insufficient.

runnable_implementation_path: Implement E23/scripts/capture_tui.py with a real PTY driving the built bp binary: load schemas, select every deployed candidate, capture 40x24 frames, and reject pdrender/stdout substitutes.

Implement E23/scripts/deliver_email.py to fetch the exact /papers/:slug/email bytes, send them through an authorized real transport with candidate/deployment headers, and persist provider receipts without secrets.
Implement E23/scripts/capture_real_client.py to bind named client, message id, receipt, open timestamp, 320px capture, semantic/accessibility evidence, and artifact SHA256.
acceptance_gates: E22 remains PASS and byte-bound; exactly 72/72 unique cells are accepted with zero proxies or provenance drift.
The real bp TUI selects all 36 records at 40x24; each of 36 messages has a transport receipt and is opened/captured in a named real client at 320px.
All applicable frozen E03, six-adversarial, semantic order, accessibility, width/overflow, explicit-error, and zero-silent-blank gates pass.
rejection_gates: Reject pdrender, stdout, non-interactive/schema-error TUI, endpoint HTML, browser preview, raw MIME alone, synthetic client capture, absent receipt/open proof, clipping, E22 drift, or any missing cell.

rollback_and_teardown.action: Delete 36 test messages and local client artifacts where authority permits, revoke transport/test-account credentials, close PTYs, prove E22 records unchanged, and defer final deployment teardown to E24.

hashes.runtime_inputs: E22 result/deployment/provenance/index digests plus bp binary digest
hashes.required_outputs: SHA256 for 72 captures, 36 delivered MIME byte streams, receipts, open proofs, manifests, cleanup, and aggregate index

assignments.two_replay_requirements: Two offline verifier replays over sealed PTY, delivery, and client-open artifacts must be byte-identical; no resend, recapture, or synthetic replacement is allowed.

assignments.title: Run sealed five-surface blind comparison and fail-closed decision
assignments.dependency_behavior: Do not seal or score unless E22 and E23 are PASS and indexes reconcile to 108+72=180 unique real cells; any block/failure emits REWORK without scoring, winner, or pilot.

capability_classification.capability: hash reconciliation, blind sealing, frozen scoring, adversarial gates, replay, rollback/quarantine decision

capability_classification.blocker: No new authority is needed after E22/E23 PASS; missing upstream authority remains a hard dependency block, never a scoring exception.

runnable_implementation_path: Implement E24/scripts/preflight.py to hash every input and require exact 180-cell uniqueness before sealing.
Implement seal.py to create opaque fixture/surface identities before the first score; implement score.py against frozen rubric/threshold/failure taxonomy only.
Implement replay.py and decide.py so two clean runs produce identical semantic, artifact, gate, and decision bytes and any hard-gate failure returns REWORK.
acceptance_gates: Exactly 180/180 unique provenance-bound real-reader cells and 30/30 adversarial cells are sealed before scoring with zero missing, duplicate, proxy, backfilled, or mutated cells.
Two clean replays have identical canonical semantic hashes, artifact hashes, gate outcomes, and decision bytes; all frozen hard gates pass, rollback is 36/36, and quarantine is 100%.
winner_selected=true only after independent verification of every hard gate; pilot_authorized=true only when winner_selected=true and the same decision replays identically.
rejection_gates: Reject and emit REWORK on dependency drift, missing capture, proxy/backfill, seal timing violation, scorer identity leak, threshold change, any hard-gate/adversarial failure, replay mismatch, incomplete rollback/quarantine, winner without all gates, or pilot without winner.

rollback_and_teardown.action: Verify restoration of 36/36 preimages, quarantine every rejected unit/cell with reason and evidence, invoke E22 deployment teardown, revoke residual credentials, and prove no production mutation.

hashes.required_inputs: SHA256 of every E22/E23 artifact plus frozen E03 inputs before sealing
hashes.required_outputs: SHA256 of seal, 180 records, gate matrix, adversarial reconciliation, each replay tree, rollback/quarantine, decision, and result

assignments.two_replay_requirements: Two clean isolated replays from the same sealed input manifest must yield byte-identical canonical outputs and decision; mismatch forces REWORK, winner_selected=false, pilot_authorized=false.
